title: AI-driven anchoring bias in mobile recharge platforms: a PLS-SEM analysis
title_zh: 移动充值平台中AI驱动的锚定效应：基于PLS-SEM的分析
title_primary: 移动充值平台中AI驱动的锚定效应：基于PLS-SEM的分析
title_secondary: AI-driven anchoring bias in mobile recharge platforms: a PLS-SEM analysis
authors: Anjali Mathews, Sunitha Sivaraman
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The study examines the structural dynamics between AI dependence and anchoring bias on mobile recharge platforms in India. It integrates a layered behavioural economic theoretical framework. It examines how AI dependence amidst a complex choice environment, perceived cognitive load, easy digital access and higher search costs influence anchoring bias in the choice of mobile recharge plans. Data is collected from the four telecom categories in India among 301 consumers who purchase prepaid mobile recharge plans via digital platforms. The PLS-SEM analysis finds that the complexity of choice and resultant higher search costs are the primary drivers of AI dependence. It implies that AI recommendation systems, which are aimed to reduce search effort, rather limit consumers’ independent evaluation of plans by creating anchoring bias. Further, the study employs complementary robustness checks using Gaussian Copula for instrument-free endogeneity correction, a quadratic effect for testing non-linearity and FIMIX PLS to confirm the absence of unobserved heterogeneity. The results reveal a significant inverted U-shaped relationship between AI dependence and anchoring bias, indicating a cognitive saturation point at which the bias plateaus at extreme levels of AI dependence. The study calls for policy interventions like targeted nudges for consumers and appropriate AI inclusive competition policies.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了印度移动充值平台上AI依赖与锚定偏差之间的结构性动态关系，并整合了一个分层行为经济学理论框架。研究考察了在复杂选择环境中，AI依赖如何通过感知认知负荷、便捷的数字访问和更高的搜索成本影响消费者在移动充值套餐选择中的锚定偏差。数据收集自印度四大电信类别中301名通过数字平台购买预付费移动充值套餐的消费者。PLS-SEM分析发现，选择复杂性及其导致的更高搜索成本是AI依赖的主要驱动因素。这意味着，旨在减少搜索努力的AI推荐系统，反而通过制造锚定偏差限制了消费者对套餐的独立评估。此外，研究采用互补稳健性检验，包括使用高斯Copula进行无工具变量的内生性校正、二次效应检验非线性以及FIMIX PLS确认不存在未观测异质性。结果显示，AI依赖与锚定偏差之间存在显著的倒U型关系，表明在AI依赖达到极端水平时，存在一个认知饱和点，偏差在此趋于平稳。研究呼吁采取政策干预措施，如针对消费者的定向助推以及适当的AI包容性竞争政策。

authors: Christopher P Chambers, Yusufcan Masatlioglu, Christopher Turansick
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The linear-in-means model is the standard empirical model of peer effects and asks that an agent’s choice or outcome is a combination of their ideal point and the mean outcome of their group. Using choice data and exogenous group variation, we develop a revealed preference style test for the linear-in-means model. This test is formulated as a linear program and can be interpreted as a condition about differentiating the behaviour of each agent in a consistent manner. We then study the identification properties of the linear-in-means model. A key takeaway from our analysis is the close relationship between the dimension of the outcome variable and identification. When the outcome variable is one-dimensional, failures of identification are generic. When the outcome variable is multidimensional, we provide natural conditions under which identification is generic.

title: Air Pollution during Religious Holidays: Evidence from Tomb-Sweeping Day
title_zh: 宗教节日期间的空气污染：来自清明节的证据
title_primary: 宗教节日期间的空气污染：来自清明节的证据
title_secondary: Air Pollution during Religious Holidays: Evidence from Tomb-Sweeping Day
authors: Hung-Hao Chang, Yu-You Liou, Chad D. Meyerhoefer
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Religious holidays are associated with changes to usual routines and special religious practices that can worsen air pollution. Using the Hakka Tomb Sweeping Day in Taiwan as an illustration, we find that religious activities lower overall air quality by 10.8% and increase levels of specific pollutants by 9.8% - 18.6%. In contrast to previous studies suggesting elevated air pollution is due to the burning of incense, joss paper and fireworks, we identify greater motor vehicle use and a decrease in travel speed as primary mechanisms. Changes in traffic also lead to a 16% increase in injuries from motor vehicle accidents. In Hakka areas serviced by rail lines we find no increase in air pollution or injuries during Tomb Sweeping Day, highlighting the benefits of public transportation to accommodate holiday travel.
abstract_zh: 宗教节日往往伴随着日常作息的变化及特定的宗教习俗，这些因素可能加剧空气污染。以台湾地区的客家清明节为例，我们发现宗教活动使整体空气质量下降10.8%，特定污染物浓度上升9.8%至18.6%。与先前研究将空气污染加剧归因于焚烧香烛、纸钱及燃放鞭炮不同，我们识别出机动车使用增加及行驶速度降低为主要机制。交通变化还导致机动车事故伤害增加16%。在设有铁路线路的客家地区，清明节期间未观察到空气污染或伤害事件的增加，这凸显了公共交通在应对节日出行需求方面的益处。

title: Measuring Macroeconomic Stars: A Framework with Scarring Effects
title_zh: 衡量宏观经济之星：具有疤痕效应的分析框架
title_primary: 衡量宏观经济之星：具有疤痕效应的分析框架
title_secondary: Measuring Macroeconomic Stars: A Framework with Scarring Effects
authors: Manuel Gonzalez-Astudillo, Jean-Philippe Laforte, Antoine Lepetit
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Potential output and the natural rate of unemployment are commonly estimated through trend-cycle decompositions, where they are identified as underlying trends reflecting slow-moving supply factors. In this paper, we extend this framework to accommodate the possibility that cyclical disturbances affect trends endogenously through "scarring" effects. Two major changes occur relative to standard specifications. First, a significant share of business-cycle fluctuations is absorbed by endogenous movements in the trends rather than shifts in the cycle. Second, the estimated cycle--relieved of explaining the persistence in real variables--tracks inflation developments more closely, including through a steeper Phillips curve. While this steeper slope implies a strong co-movement between inflation and real activity in response to cyclical shocks, such strong co-movement is rarely apparent in the data. Consequently, the estimation shows a shift toward more sizable changes in the purely supply-driven components of the trends, mirrored by smaller innovations in the cycle process. In turn, this rebalancing entails different historical paths for the activity gaps, carrying important implications for the conduct of monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 潜在产出与自然失业率通常通过趋势-周期分解进行估计，其中它们被识别为反映缓慢变动的供给因素的潜在趋势。在本文中，我们扩展了这一框架，以容纳周期性扰动通过“疤痕效应”内生地影响趋势的可能性。与标准设定相比，发生了两个重大变化。首先，商业周期波动的显著份额被趋势的内生变动所吸收，而非周期的变动。其次，估计出的周期——不再承担解释实际变量持续性的任务——更紧密地追踪通胀动态，包括通过更陡峭的菲利普斯曲线。尽管这一更陡峭的斜率意味着周期性冲击下通胀与实际活动之间存在强烈的联动，但这种强烈联动在数据中很少显现。因此，估计结果显示，趋势中纯供给驱动成分的变化幅度增大，而周期过程的创新幅度相应减小。这种再平衡反过来导致了活动缺口的不同历史路径，对货币政策的实施具有重要含义。

title: A Tale of Demand and Supply for Central Bank Reserves
title_zh: 中央银行准备金需求与供给的故事
title_primary: 中央银行准备金需求与供给的故事
title_secondary: A Tale of Demand and Supply for Central Bank Reserves
authors: Sriya Anbil, Sebastian Infante, Zeynep Senyuz
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In an ample-reserves framework, administered rates anchor money markets but suppress information from unsecured interbank trading. We recover that information by isolating the small interbank segment of the federal funds market. Using high-frequency bank-level data, we employ deposit shocks as an instrument for bank borrowing demand. Our analysis reveals that non-bank lenders, such as Federal Home Loan Banks, supply funds elastically, whereas bank lenders exhibit price inelasticity, which intensifies as their reserve balances decline, particularly for bankers’ banks. This interbank segment highlights distributional frictions in the federal funds market that emerge well before aggregate reserves become scarce and provides new evidence on monetary policy transmission in an ample-reserves regime.
abstract_zh: 在充裕准备金框架下，管理利率锚定货币市场，但抑制了无担保银行间交易的信息。我们通过隔离联邦基金市场中规模较小的银行间部分来恢复这些信息。利用高频银行层面数据，我们将存款冲击作为银行借款需求的工具变量。分析揭示，非银行贷方（如联邦住房贷款银行）弹性供应资金，而银行贷方则表现出价格非弹性，且随着其准备金余额下降而加剧，尤其是对银行家的银行而言。这一银行间部分凸显了联邦基金市场中在总准备金变得稀缺之前就已出现的分配摩擦，并为充裕准备金制度下的货币政策传导提供了新证据。

title: Pareto optimal uncertainty sharing under smooth ambiguity
title_zh: 平滑模糊下的帕累托最优不确定性分担
title_primary: 平滑模糊下的帕累托最优不确定性分担
title_secondary: Pareto optimal uncertainty sharing under smooth ambiguity
authors: Riccardo Formenti
official: 官方在线 2026-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We extend the classical syndicate model to a setting with ambiguous beliefs, where agents face both risk and ambiguity and have heterogeneous smooth ambiguity preferences. Our main theorem generalizes Borch’s seminal result by providing necessary and sufficient conditions for Pareto optimality in this environment: an uncertainty-sharing contract is Pareto-optimal if and only if agents’ marginal utilities, weighted by ambiguity-adjusted belief densities, are proportional across states. The ambiguity-adjusted densities reflect how ambiguity aversion tilts evaluation toward adverse probabilistic models, with weights proportional to the marginal ambiguity attitude. The welfare interpretation is standard: Pareto-optimal contracts coincide with maximizers of a weighted social-welfare functional, and the proportionality constants equal the associated Pareto weights. The characterization nests Borch’s rule, reducing to proportional marginal utilities when beliefs are unambiguous or agents are ambiguity neutral.
abstract_zh: 我们将经典辛迪加模型扩展至信念模糊的环境，其中代理人同时面临风险与模糊，并具有异质平滑模糊偏好。我们的主要定理推广了博尔奇的开创性成果，在此环境中提供了帕累托最优性的必要且充分条件：当且仅当代理人的边际效用，经模糊调整后的信念密度加权，在各状态间成比例时，不确定性分担契约才是帕累托最优的。模糊调整后的密度反映了模糊厌恶如何将评估偏向于不利的概率模型，其权重与边际模糊态度成比例。福利解释是标准的：帕累托最优契约与加权社会福利泛函的最大化者一致，且比例常数等于相应的帕累托权重。该特征化嵌套了博尔奇规则，当信念明确或代理人模糊中性时，简化为边际效用成比例。

title: Group Health Insurance Versus ACA Marketplaces: Selection, Subsidies, and Welfare
title_zh: 团体健康保险与ACA市场：选择、补贴与福利
title_primary: 团体健康保险与ACA市场：选择、补贴与福利
title_secondary: Group Health Insurance Versus ACA Marketplaces: Selection, Subsidies, and Welfare
authors: Fleitas, Sebastian, Fleming, Caitlyn, Gowrisankaran, Gautam, Lo Sasso, Anthony
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) changed incentives for individual and employer-sponsored insurance. Using unique small group market (SGM) data with detailed claims and enrollment information, we analyze the welfare gains across households in the SGM from alternative formulations of ACA health insurance exchanges (HIXs). Accounting for observable heterogeneity increases estimated demand elasticities. Shutting down the SGM would reduce equilibrium adverse selection in HIX-type markets, increasing welfare for households moved to HIXs by $842 annually. The majority of households would obtain higher equilibrium welfare from HIXs, stemming from having more choices. Adding the 2014 ACA penalties only modestly decreases adverse selection.
abstract_zh: 《平价医疗法案》（ACA）改变了对个人及雇主赞助保险的激励。利用包含详细理赔和参保信息的独特小团体市场（SGM）数据，我们分析了ACA健康保险交易所（HIXs）不同方案下小团体市场中各家庭福利收益的变化。考虑可观测异质性会提高估计的需求弹性。关闭小团体市场将减少HIX型市场中的均衡逆向选择，使迁至HIX的家庭每年福利增加842美元。大多数家庭将从HIX中获得更高的均衡福利，这源于更多的选择。加入2014年ACA罚则仅略微降低了逆向选择。

title: Spillovers from export credit guarantees
title_zh: 出口信用担保的溢出效应
title_primary: 出口信用担保的溢出效应
title_secondary: Spillovers from export credit guarantees
authors: Ina C. Jäkel
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Most countries use export credit agencies (ECAs) to mitigate export‐related credit constraints. Only few firms benefit directly from these credit schemes. In this paper, I analyze potential spillover effects from export credit guarantees to other firms. Using firm‐level data from the Danish ECA and exploiting detailed firm‐product‐level production and purchase statistics, I derive new measures for horizontal and backward spillovers at the firm‐product and firm levels. Results show that potential suppliers upstream increase their sales of those products that are purchased by the firm(s) receiving export credit guarantees. Moreover, employment and total sales of potential suppliers increase as well. These findings speak to the transmission of large export shocks (here reflected in the issuance of export credit guarantees) to other domestic firms via customer‐supplier linkages. In contrast, I find little evidence of negative effects on domestic producers when export credit guarantees are given to their competitors.
abstract_zh: 大多数国家通过出口信用机构（ECAs）来缓解与出口相关的信贷约束，但仅有少数企业能直接受益于这些信贷计划。本文分析了出口信用担保对其他企业的潜在溢出效应。基于丹麦出口信用机构的企业层面数据，并利用详细的企业-产品层面生产与采购统计，我在企业-产品和企业层面构建了横向与后向溢出的新测度指标。研究结果表明，上游潜在供应商会增加其向获得出口信用担保的企业所采购产品的销售额。此外，这些潜在供应商的就业与总销售额也同步增长。这些发现揭示了大型出口冲击（此处体现为出口信用担保的发放）如何通过客户-供应商关联传导至国内其他企业。相比之下，当出口信用担保给予竞争对手时，我并未发现对国内生产者产生负面效应的显著证据。

title: Self-Fulfilling Credit Scores
title_zh: 自我实现的信用评分
title_primary: 自我实现的信用评分
title_secondary: Self-Fulfilling Credit Scores
authors: Victor Duarte, Julia Fonseca
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A decline in credit scores can worsen the borrower's financial position, making default a self-fulfilling prophecy. We estimate the causal effect of credit scores on default using a rule that counts multiple inquiries within 14 days as one, moving scores without changing credit reports. Regression discontinuity estimates around the 14-day cut-off show that an additional counted inquiry lowers scores by five points on average. Default does not respond among consumers with clean records, but rises by 3.2 percentage points over two years among those with prior derogatories. For these consumers, at least 13 percent of the relationship between scores and default is self-fulfilling. We show that scorers would want to limit self-fulfilling defaults if their objective is forecast accuracy, but not if it is separating defaulters from non-defaulters, because that objective rewards the score for the defaults it causes.
abstract_zh: 信用评分下降可能恶化借款人的财务状况，使违约成为自我实现的预言。我们利用一项规则——将14天内多次查询合并为一次，从而在不改变信用报告的情况下调整评分——来估计信用评分对违约的因果效应。基于14天临界点的断点回归估计显示，每增加一次被计入的查询平均会使评分降低5分。在信用记录良好的消费者中，违约并未出现显著变化；但在有不良记录的消费者中，两年内违约率上升了3.2个百分点。对于这些消费者而言，评分与违约之间至少13%的关系是自我实现的。研究表明，若评分机构的目标是预测准确性，它们会倾向于限制自我实现的违约；但若目标是区分违约者与非违约者，则不会如此，因为后一目标会因评分引发的违约而奖励该评分。

title: Were American Parents Really Selfish? Child Labour in the 19th Century
title_zh: 19世纪的美国父母真的自私吗？童工问题研究
title_primary: 19世纪的美国父母真的自私吗？童工问题研究
title_secondary: Were American Parents Really Selfish? Child Labour in the 19th Century
authors: Venkataraman Bhaskar, Bishnupriya Gupta, Sara Horrell, Jane Humphries, Jacob Weisdorf 等
official: 官方在线 2006-05-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: we examine household decisions and parental altruism vis-a-vis their children. Contrary to Parsons and Goldin (1989), we find that parental location choices were dictated by constraints rather than the desire to exploit child labour opportunities. We also find signfiicant income effects on child labour supply, indicating that rising affluence played an important part in the secular decline of child labour. We also find that the effects of childrens' income on their own consumption are weak, once child labour is controlled for.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了家庭决策及其对子女的利他主义行为。与帕森斯和戈尔丁（1989）的观点相反，我们发现父母的区位选择是由约束条件决定的，而非出于利用童工机会的意愿。我们还发现收入对童工供给具有显著影响，这表明财富增长在童工现象的长期减少中发挥了重要作用。此外，在控制童工因素后，我们发现子女收入对其自身消费的影响较弱。

title: Can author manipulation of AI referees be welfare improving?
title_zh: 作者操纵AI审稿人能否提升福利？
title_primary: 作者操纵AI审稿人能否提升福利？
title_secondary: Can author manipulation of AI referees be welfare improving?
authors: Joshua S. Gans
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper asks whether authors’ ability to manipulate AI referees necessarily undermines peer review, or whether it can sometimes improve it. We model a journal in which authors privately know quality, referees choose between costly manual review and cheap AI delegation, and editors may investigate suspicious recommendations. Hidden prompts can force AI to recommend acceptance, but prompt detection is imperfect. With the baseline referee incentives and sequentially rational, non-committed investigation, manual-only review is unsustainable once AI is available, and there is no robust pure-strategy AI-only equilibrium with manipulation. Most notably, under the welfare criterion studied here, prompt injection can be welfare improving on an open set of primitives: in certain monitoring equilibria, manipulation makes positive AI reports more suspicious or more exposed to audit, induces editor investigation, and helps sustain manual review where prompt-free standard inspection would fail. Stronger prompt detection is, therefore, not unconditionally better; within the focal equilibrium menu, it can eliminate a monitoring regime without replacing it with a higher-welfare one. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 本文探讨作者操纵AI审稿人的能力是否必然损害同行评审，抑或有时能改进评审机制。我们构建了一个期刊模型：作者私下知晓论文质量，审稿人可在高成本人工评审与低成本AI委托之间选择，编辑则可能对可疑推荐展开调查。隐藏提示可强制AI推荐接收，但提示检测并不完美。在基准审稿人激励与序贯理性、非承诺调查条件下，一旦AI可用，纯人工评审便不可持续，且不存在稳健的纯策略AI均衡（含操纵行为）。尤为值得注意的是，在所研究的福利标准下，提示注入可在开集参数上改善福利：在某些监控均衡中，操纵行为使正面AI报告更可疑或更易受审计，促使编辑展开调查，并在无提示的标准审查失效时维持人工评审。因此，更强的提示检测并非无条件更优；在焦点均衡集合内，它可能消除一种监控机制，却未代之以更高福利的机制。

title: Firm Heterogeneity, Market Power and Macroeconomic Fragility
title_zh: 企业异质性、市场势力与宏观经济脆弱性
title_primary: 企业异质性、市场势力与宏观经济脆弱性
title_secondary: Firm Heterogeneity, Market Power and Macroeconomic Fragility
authors: Ferrari, Alessandro, Queirós, Francisco
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how firm heterogeneity and market power affect macroeconomic fragility, defined as the probability of long slumps. We propose a theory where the positive interaction between firm entry, competition, and factor supply can give rise to multiple steady-states. We show that when firms are highly heterogeneous in terms of productivities, even small temporary shocks can trigger firm exit and make the economy spiral into a competition-driven poverty trap. We calibrate our model to incorporate the well-documented trends on rising firm heterogeneity in the US economy, and show that they significantly increase the likelihood and length of slow recoveries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业异质性与市场势力如何影响宏观经济脆弱性，即长期衰退的概率。我们提出一个理论，其中企业进入、竞争与要素供给之间的正向互动可能导致多重稳态。研究表明，当企业在生产率方面高度异质时，即使是微小的暂时性冲击也可能引发企业退出，并使经济陷入竞争驱动的贫困陷阱。我们通过校准模型纳入美国经济中企业异质性上升的已有趋势，并证明这些趋势显著增加了缓慢复苏的可能性与持续时间。

title: Digitalization and Credit Markets: Evidence from eInvoicing
title_zh: 数字化与信贷市场：来自电子发票的证据
title_primary: 数字化与信贷市场：来自电子发票的证据
title_secondary: Digitalization and Credit Markets: Evidence from eInvoicing
authors: David Martinez-Miera, Alejandro Casado, Marco Giometti, Jose Gutierrez, Alexandra Matyunina 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We document the effects of electronic invoicing (eInvoicing) on credit markets. By making invoices more standardized, verifiable, and harder to falsify, eInvoicing changes lenders’ information sets, facilitating invoice-based financing and credit risk assessment. We exploit a regional eInvoicing mandate and administrative credit data using a difference-in-differences design to provide three main insights. First, credit reallocates toward firms already relying on invoice-based credit (“invoice firms”) and away from non-invoice firms. Second, the cost of (non-)invoice credit falls (rises) for (non-)invoice firms, consistent with a supply-driven mechanism. Third, banks’ information production changes: eInvoicing widens (reduces) the dispersion of rates and banks’ risk assessments and improves (worsens) their predictive accuracy for (non-)invoice firms. Overall, eInvoicing reshapes credit market outcomes, with uneven effects across borrowers.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了电子发票对信贷市场的影响。通过使发票更加标准化、可验证且难以伪造，电子发票改变了贷款人的信息集，促进了基于发票的融资和信用风险评估。我们利用地区性电子发票强制政策及行政信贷数据，采用双重差分法得出三项主要发现。第一，信贷资源向已依赖发票信贷的企业（"发票企业"）重新配置，同时从非发票企业流出。第二，发票企业（非发票企业）的（非）发票信贷成本下降（上升），这与供给驱动机制一致。第三，银行的信息生产发生变化：电子发票扩大了（缩小了）利率和银行风险评估的离散程度，并改善（恶化）了对发票企业（非发票企业）的预测准确性。总体而言，电子发票重塑了信贷市场格局，但对不同借款人的影响存在差异。

title: Déjà Vu? When the Lab Mimics the Field
title_zh: 既视感？当实验室模拟现实世界时
title_primary: 既视感？当实验室模拟现实世界时
title_secondary: Déjà Vu? When the Lab Mimics the Field
authors: Juan Sentana, Gonzalo Gómez-Bengoechea
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We explore whether experiments involving strategic interactions yield the same conclusions regardless of the environment they take place in. We do so by comparing the behavior of a group of individuals when they play the same two-person zero-sum game in both a soccer stadium (the field) and a video game (the lab). We conduct our experiment with professional soccer players and inexperienced college students to determine if the abilities acquired in the field apply to both environments. Our findings show that while both groups behave consistently with the implications of mixed strategy equilibrium in the field, their behavior rejects the theory in the lab, where both groups seem to follow a reinforcement learning model.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了涉及策略互动的实验是否在不同环境下得出相同结论。为此，我们比较了同一组个体在足球场（实地）和电子游戏（实验室）中玩相同的两人零和游戏时的行为。我们以职业足球运动员和缺乏经验的大学生为实验对象，以确定在实地获得的能力是否适用于两种环境。研究结果显示，尽管两组在实地中的行为与混合策略均衡的含义一致，但在实验室中，他们的行为却拒绝了该理论，两组似乎都遵循强化学习模型。

title: High-speed rail and China’s electric vehicle adoption miracle
title_zh: 高铁与中国电动汽车普及奇迹
title_primary: 高铁与中国电动汽车普及奇迹
title_secondary: High-speed rail and China’s electric vehicle adoption miracle
authors: Hanming Fang, Ming Li, Long Wang, Yang Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using China's expansion of the high-speed rail system (HSR) as a quasi-natural experiment, we analyze the comprehensive vehicle registration data from 2010 to 2023 to estimate the causal impact of HSR connectivity on the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs).Implementing several identification strategies, including staggered difference-in-differences (DID), Callaway and Sant'Anna (CS) DID, and two instrumental-variable approaches, we consistently find that, by alleviating range anxiety, the expansion of HSR can account for up to one third of the increase in EV market share and EV sales in China during our sample period, with effects particularly pronounced in cities served by faster HSR lines.The results remain robust when controlling for local industrial policies, charging infrastructure growth, supply-side factors, and economic development.We also find that HSR connectivity amplifies the effectiveness of charging infrastructure and consumer purchase subsidies in promoting EV adoption.
abstract_zh: 以中国高铁系统扩张作为准自然实验，我们分析了2010年至2023年的综合车辆登记数据，以估计高铁连通性对电动汽车采用率的因果影响。通过实施多种识别策略，包括交错双重差分法（DID）、Callaway和Sant'Anna（CS）DID以及两种工具变量方法，我们一致发现，通过缓解里程焦虑，高铁扩张可解释样本期内中国电动汽车市场份额及销量增长的三分之一，且这一效应在高铁线路速度更快的城市尤为显著。在控制地方产业政策、充电基础设施增长、供给侧因素及经济发展水平后，结果依然稳健。我们还发现，高铁连通性增强了充电基础设施和消费者购车补贴在促进电动汽车采用方面的有效性。

title: The affective cost of spending: neuroeconomic and experimental evidence on the pain of paying
title_zh: 消费的情感成本：关于支付痛苦的神经经济学与实验证据
title_primary: 消费的情感成本：关于支付痛苦的神经经济学与实验证据
title_secondary: The affective cost of spending: neuroeconomic and experimental evidence on the pain of paying
authors: Nicole Robitaille, Hilke Plassmann, Nina Mazar, Axel Lindner
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The metaphor of "pain of paying" has shaped behavioral economics for decades, yet direct evidence that spending money elicits literal pain remains elusive. Building on Camerer et al.'s (2005) neuroeconomic framework, we present converging evidence from two studies demonstrating that payment decisions activate affective pain-processing circuits. In a correlational pilot study, we use fMRI during incentive-compatible purchase decisions to show that activity in the anterior insula—a key region in affective pain processing—correlates parametrically with price magnitude. Critically, we find that paying with money activates affective but not somatosensory pain networks in the brain, whereas paying with electric shocks activates both. In the main study, we establish causality through a novel reverse-placebo paradigm in which participants believed they had taken pain-modulating drugs. Only affective pain enhancing placebos influenced valuation: participants given affective pain “enhancers” exhibited higher willingness to pay than those given affective “relievers,” though neither condition differed significantly from the untreated control. These findings provide the first causal evidence that the pain of paying constitutes a genuine affective experience that shapes economic valuation. We discuss implications for models of consumer choice, mental accounting, and behavioral policy interventions aimed at improving financial decision-making.
abstract_zh: 支付的痛苦”这一隐喻塑造了行为经济学数十年，然而，关于花钱会引发真实疼痛的直接证据仍然难以捉摸。基于Camerer等人（2005年）的神经经济学框架，我们通过两项研究提供了汇聚的证据，表明支付决策会激活情感性疼痛处理回路。在一项相关性预实验中，我们使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）在激励相容的购买决策中显示，前脑岛——情感性疼痛处理的关键区域——的活动与价格幅度呈参数性相关。关键的是，我们发现用金钱支付激活的是大脑中的情感性而非躯体感觉性疼痛网络，而用电击支付则同时激活两者。在主要研究中，我们通过一种新颖的反向安慰剂范式确立了因果关系，在该范式中，参与者相信他们服用了调节疼痛的药物。只有情感性疼痛增强安慰剂影响了估值：接受情感性疼痛“增强剂”的参与者比接受情感性“缓解剂”的参与者表现出更高的支付意愿，尽管这两种情况与未治疗对照组相比均无显著差异。这些发现首次提供了因果证据，表明支付的痛苦构成了一种真实的情感体验，能够塑造经济估值。我们讨论了这些发现对消费者选择模型、心理账户以及旨在改善财务决策的行为政策干预的启示。

title: Labor Market Consequences of Generative AI: Early Evidence from Norway
title_zh: 生成式人工智能对劳动力市场的影响：来自挪威的早期证据
title_primary: 生成式人工智能对劳动力市场的影响：来自挪威的早期证据
title_secondary: Labor Market Consequences of Generative AI: Early Evidence from Norway
authors: Dennis Facius & Roberto Iacono
official: 官方在线 2022-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Does Generative AI displace early-career workers? We provide population-wide evidence from Norwegian administrative registers, 2015 through March 2025, exploiting the November 2022 release of ChatGPT as an availability shock. Using the within-firm composition difference-in-differences employed in recent work, supplemented with a synthetic difference-in-differences at the occupation level and a firm-level shift-share design, we find no robust evidence of employment displacement among young workers in highly AI-exposed occupations, nor any robust response across other age cohorts or on incumbent labor-market outcomes. While estimated coefficients for young workers are negative, in line with the existing literature, they are small and statistically insignificant. A backdating exercise on the synthetic difference-in-differences yields larger absolute estimates than the actual treatment date across most age bands. This suggests the apparent post-2022 decline reflects, at least in part, pre-existing secular trends rather than a clean AI-period break.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能是否取代了早期职业工作者？我们利用挪威行政登记数据（2015年至2025年3月）提供全人口层面的证据，以2022年11月ChatGPT的发布作为可得性冲击。采用近期研究中使用的企业内构成双重差分法，辅以职业层面的合成双重差分法和企业层面的份额转移设计，我们未发现年轻工作者在高人工智能暴露职业中存在就业替代的稳健证据，也未发现其他年龄群体或现有劳动力市场结果存在稳健反应。尽管年轻工作者的估计系数为负，与现有文献一致，但系数较小且统计上不显著。对合成双重差分法进行回溯检验发现，在大多数年龄段中，实际处理日期之前的绝对估计值大于实际处理日期之后的估计值。这表明2022年后的表面下降至少部分反映了既有的长期趋势，而非人工智能时期的明确结构性断裂。

title: How Efficient was the Affordable Care Act at Reducing Uninsured Rates?
title_zh: 《平价医疗法案在降低未参保率方面的效率如何？》
title_primary: 《平价医疗法案在降低未参保率方面的效率如何？》
title_secondary: How Efficient was the Affordable Care Act at Reducing Uninsured Rates?
authors: Anuj Gangopadhyaya, Robert Kaestner
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: One way to measure the efficiency of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) is the extent to which gains in publicly supported health insurance reduced uninsured rates. Using data from the 2008–2024 American Community Survey, we examine time trends in rates of uninsured, public insurance coverage, and employer-sponsored insurance (ESI) by groups defined by the ratio of income to the Federal Poverty Line (FPL). We obtain estimates of associations between changes in public coverage and changes in uninsured and ESI exploiting state-by-year variation in ACA implementation. Importantly, we estimate the total effect of the ACA—including both the Medicaid expansion and Marketplace coverage—on uninsured and ESI rates. For adults in households below 150% of the federal poverty level (FPL), increases in public insurance coverage were associated with one-for-one decrease in uninsured and no change in ESI. For adults with incomes between 151%–400% FPL, each percentage point increase in public coverage was associated with about a 0.6 percentage point decrease in uninsured and a 0.4 decrease, or crowd out, in ESI. Crowd-out was larger among groups with higher pre-ACA ESI rates such as parents and married adults. Using variation from the Medicaid expansion alone to evaluate the ACA’s effect on ESI leads to overstating crowd-out among low-income adults (below 150% FPL) and understating crowd-out among higher-income adults (above 250% FPL). Our findings suggest that policies intended to subsidize health insurance of higher income groups, for example, the enhanced premium subsidies, are far less efficient than policies intended to further expand public insurance to low-income groups, for example, in non-expansion states.
abstract_zh: 衡量《平价医疗法案》（ACA）效率的一个方法是，公共资助医疗保险的覆盖增长在多大程度上降低了未参保率。利用2008-2024年美国社区调查数据，我们按收入与联邦贫困线（FPL）之比划分群体，考察了未参保率、公共保险覆盖率以及雇主提供保险（ESI）的时间趋势。我们利用各州在ACA实施中的年度差异，估算了公共保险覆盖率变化与未参保率及ESI变化之间的关联。重要的是，我们评估了ACA的总体效应——包括医疗补助扩展和市场保险覆盖——对未参保率和ESI的影响。对于家庭收入低于联邦贫困线150%的成年人，公共保险覆盖率的增加与未参保率的一对一下降相关，而ESI无变化。对于收入在联邦贫困线151%-400%之间的成年人，公共保险覆盖率每增加一个百分点，未参保率下降约0.6个百分点，ESI下降0.4个百分点（即挤出效应）。在ACA实施前ESI率较高的群体（如父母和已婚成年人）中，挤出效应更大。仅利用医疗补助扩展的变异来评估ACA对ESI的影响，会导致低估低收入成年人（低于150% FPL）的挤出效应，而高估高收入成年人（高于250% FPL）的挤出效应。我们的研究结果表明，旨在补贴高收入群体医疗保险的政策（例如增强型保费补贴）远不如旨在进一步向低收入群体扩展公共保险的政策（例如在非扩展州）有效。

title: A data-driven econo-financial stress-testing framework to estimate the effect of supply chain networks on financial systemic risk
title_zh: 基于数据的经济金融压力测试框架：评估供应链网络对金融系统性风险的影响
title_primary: 基于数据的经济金融压力测试框架：评估供应链网络对金融系统性风险的影响
title_secondary: A data-driven econo-financial stress-testing framework to estimate the effect of supply chain networks on financial systemic risk
authors: Jan Fialkowski, Christian Diem, András Borsos, Stefan Thurner
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Supply chain disruptions constitute a widely neglected risk for financial stability. As in financial networks, systemic risk in supply chain networks (SCNs) arises when the local failure of a single or a small group of firms impacts the production of others and might trigger cascading drops in production that affect significant parts of the economy. Here, we study how systemic risk in SCNs translates into financial systemic risk through a mechanism where supply chain contagion leads to correlated bank-firm loan defaults. We propose a financial stress-testing framework for macro-prudential applications that features a national firm level SCN in combination with bank-firm loans and the interbank network. The model is calibrated with a unique data set including about 1 million firm-level supply links, practically all bank-firm loans, and all interbank loans in Hungary. As a showcase we implement a real COVID-19 shock scenario based on firm-level labour data. This model allows us to study how the disruption dynamics in the real economy can lead to and amplify interbank solvency contagion dynamics. We estimate to what extent SCN contagion amplifies financial systemic risk, discuss the relative importance of these contagion channels, and find an increase of interbank contagion of 70% when SCN contagion is present. A key finding is that the interaction of SCN contagion and financial network contagion amplifies financial systemic risks and leads to heavier tails of banks’ loss distributions. We then examine the financial systemic risk of individual firm failures and find that interbank contagion can amplify bank equity losses from supply-chain-contagion-induced defaults by up to 28%. This framework is the first financial systemic risk model that takes real economy shocks mediated by supply chain contagion into account at the agent-level. This opens a path for a direct and event-driven understanding of the dynamical interaction between the real economy and financial systems.
abstract_zh: 供应链中断构成了金融稳定性中一个被广泛忽视的风险。与金融网络相似，在供应链网络中，当单个或少数企业的局部失败影响到其他企业的生产，并可能引发波及经济重要部分的生产连锁下降时，系统性风险便随之产生。在此，我们研究供应链网络中的系统性风险如何通过一种机制转化为金融系统性风险，该机制中供应链传染导致银行与企业贷款违约的相关性增加。我们提出一个适用于宏观审慎应用的金融压力测试框架，该框架结合了国家级企业层面的供应链网络、银行-企业贷款以及银行间网络。模型利用一个独特的数据集进行校准，该数据集包含约100万条企业层面的供应链接、几乎所有的银行-企业贷款以及匈牙利所有的银行间贷款。作为示例，我们基于企业层面的劳动力数据实施了一个真实的COVID-19冲击情景。该模型使我们能够研究实体经济中的中断动态如何导致并放大银行间偿付能力传染动态。我们估计了供应链网络传染在多大程度上放大金融系统性风险，讨论了这些传染渠道的相对重要性，并发现当存在供应链网络传染时，银行间传染增加了70%。一个关键发现是，供应链网络传染与金融网络传染的相互作用放大了金融系统性风险，并导致银行损失分布的尾部更重。随后，我们考察了单个企业失败的金融系统性风险，发现银行间传染可以将由供应链传染引发的违约导致的银行股本损失放大至多28%。该框架是首个在代理层面考虑由供应链传染介导的实体经济冲击的金融系统性风险模型。这为直接且事件驱动地理解实体经济与金融系统之间的动态相互作用开辟了道路。

title: Gender Gaps in the Urban Wage Premium
title_zh: 城市工资溢价中的性别差距
title_primary: 城市工资溢价中的性别差距
title_secondary: Gender Gaps in the Urban Wage Premium
authors: Kenza Elass, Cecilia García-Peñalosa, Christian Schluter
official: 官方在线 2024-10-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the economic geography of gender wage gaps to understand the role that location plays in gender earning differences. Using panelised administrative data for the universe of French workers, our findings indicate that women benefit relatively more from density than men, with an urban wage premium (return to urban density) 48% higher than for men. We identify a number of factors that explain this gap, with a large share being explained by the structure of the local labour market, notably, the extent of occupational segregation. Another important factor is commuting patterns, while childcare availability plays only a moderate role.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了性别工资差距的经济地理学，以理解地理位置在性别收入差异中的作用。利用法国全体劳动者的面板化行政数据，研究结果表明，女性从城市密度中获得的相对收益高于男性，其城市工资溢价（城市密度的回报率）比男性高出48%。我们识别出若干解释这一差距的因素，其中很大一部分归因于当地劳动力市场的结构，尤其是职业隔离的程度。另一个重要因素是通勤模式，而儿童保育的可获得性仅起到中等程度的作用。

title: Particle MCMC and the correlated particle hybrid sampler for state space models
title_zh: 粒子马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛与相关粒子混合采样器在状态空间模型中的应用
title_primary: 粒子马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛与相关粒子混合采样器在状态空间模型中的应用
title_secondary: Particle MCMC and the correlated particle hybrid sampler for state space models
authors: David Gunawan, Chris Carter, Robert Kohn
official: 官方在线 2024-05-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Particle Markov Chain Monte Carlo (PMCMC) is a powerful approach to Bayesian computation for general state space models. Our article enables PMCMC to handle a larger number of observations and parameters compared to previous approaches by generating the parameters that are highly correlated with the states in a pseudo-marginal step(s) with the states ‘integrated out’; the rest of the parameters are generated conditional on the states. We make the pseudo-marginal step much more efficient than previous approaches by positively correlating the numerator and denominator in the Metropolis–Hastings acceptance probability in a novel way by expressing the target density of the PMCMC in terms of the basic uniform or normal random numbers used in the sequential Monte Carlo algorithm, instead of the standard way which expresses the target density in terms of the state particles. We also show that the new sampler combines and generalizes two separate particle MCMC approaches: particle Gibbs and the correlated pseudo-marginal Metropolis–Hastings. We investigate the performance of this hybrid sampler empirically by applying it to univariate and multivariate stochastic volatility models having both a large number of parameters and a large number of latent states and show that it is much more efficient than competing PMCMC methods. An online supplement to the article and computer code are available online.

title: Dollar Trinity and the Global Financial Cycle
title_zh: 美元三位一体与全球金融周期
title_primary: 美元三位一体与全球金融周期
title_secondary: Dollar Trinity and the Global Financial Cycle
authors: Gernot Müller, Georgios Georgiadis, Ben Schumann
official: 官方在线 2023-09-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a two-country business-cycle model of the US and the rest of the world with dollar dominance in trade invoicing, in cross-border credit, and in safe assets. The interplay between these elements---dollar trinity---rationalizes salient features of the Global Financial Cycle in the data: When its tide subsides, the dollar appreciates, financial conditions tighten, the world business cycle slows down, and emerging-market central banks face a trade-off between mitigating the recession and dampening price pressures. We find the dollar is no sideshow in this, but central for the transmission of the Global Financial Cycle to the world economy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含美国与世界其他地区的两国商业周期模型，其中美元在贸易计价、跨境信贷和安全资产领域占据主导地位。这些要素之间的相互作用——美元三位一体——合理化了数据中全球金融周期的显著特征：当美元潮汐退去时，美元升值，金融状况收紧，全球商业周期放缓，新兴市场央行面临缓解经济衰退与抑制价格压力之间的权衡。我们发现，美元在此过程中并非配角，而是全球金融周期向世界经济传导的核心环节。

title: Consequentiality, Elicitation Formats, and the Willingness-To-Pay for Green Electricity: Evidence from Germany
title_zh: 后果性、诱导格式与绿色电力支付意愿：来自德国的证据
title_primary: 后果性、诱导格式与绿色电力支付意愿：来自德国的证据
title_secondary: Consequentiality, Elicitation Formats, and the Willingness-To-Pay for Green Electricity: Evidence from Germany
authors: Andor, M. A., Frondel, M., Horvath, M.
official: 官方在线 2021-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Based on hypothetical responses originating from a large-scale survey among about 6,000 German households, this study investigates the discrepancy in willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates for green electricity across single-binary-choice and open-ended valuation formats. Recognizing that respondents self-select into two groups distinguished by their belief in their answers’ consequences for policy making, we employ a switching regression model that accounts for the potential endogeneity of respondents’ belief in consequences and biases from sample selectivity. Contrasting with the received literature, we find WTP bids that tend to be higher among those respondents who obtained questions in the open-ended format, rather than single-binary-choice questions. JEL D03D12Q48Q50H41
abstract_zh: 基于对约6000户德国家庭的大规模调查所获得的假设性回答，本研究探讨了在单一二元选择与开放式估值格式下，绿色电力支付意愿（WTP）估计值的差异。鉴于受访者根据其对回答在政策制定中后果的信念，自我选择分为两组，我们采用切换回归模型，该模型考虑了受访者信念后果的潜在内生性以及样本选择性带来的偏差。与现有文献相反，我们发现，在开放式格式下接受问题的受访者所给出的WTP报价往往高于单一二元选择问题下的报价。JEL分类号：D03，D12，Q48，Q50，H41
